items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I was there with Kit Howard, Jim Robinson, Paul Bones, Davis on drums, Paul Bones on saxophone, I was on piano

ctx.x: That was, uh, who was band was that? I don't remember who was playing there. You don't know who was at La Vida?
Oh, La Vida? Yeah, I was there with Kit Howard, Jim Robinson, Paul Bones, Davis on drums, Paul Bones on saxophone, I was on piano, Jim Robinson on tramboy, and Kit Howard.
